metadata.name: rod_pack_minter
metadata.description: Reign of Desire card packs: pays and mints a whole pack of Bubblegum v1 cNFTs in one transaction

accounts.name: player
docs: Pays the price, the transaction fee, the PendingPack rent (returned when the pack is opened or refunded) and
the opener's fee deposit.

accounts.name: approver
docs: The backend's approver key: every purchase goes through the game's order flow.

accounts.name: player_token
docs: The player's token account of the payment currency (transfer_checked enforces owner and mint).

accounts.name: vault
docs: The vault of the payment currency (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: $BOOTY or $LUST mint (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: lust_config
docs: Required for $LUST payments.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin or the tree funder; pays the tree config rent.

accounts.name: opener
docs: Sends the transaction and receives the player's fee deposit. Also the Bubblegum payer (which pays nothing).

accounts.name: player
docs: Receives the cards and the PendingPack's rent.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The vault of the pack's currency (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Mint of the pack's currency (checked in the handler); writable for the $LUST burn.

accounts.name: lust_config
docs: Required for $LUST packs.

accounts.name: caller
docs: The backend approver (automatically) or the admin. Not anyone: the new draw slot is the slot the redraw lands
in, so a player or a colluding validator must not be able to time it.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The vault of the pack's currency (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: player_token
docs: A token account of the pack's currency owned by the player.

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Mint of the pack's currency (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: lust_config
docs: Required for $LUST packs.

types.name: CardTable
docs: The cards of one expansion. PDA ["cards", expansion id as u16 LE]. Only this small header is (de)serialised by
Anchor; the cards follow it as fixed-size entries read and written in place, so even a full table never has to
fit in the 32 KiB heap. Entry: rarity u8 | name_len u8 | name [u8; 32] | suffix_len u8 | uri_suffix [u8; 72].

types.name: Config
docs: Global settings. PDA ["config"].

fields.name: admin
docs: Signs every admin instruction (James's admin key).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Set by `propose_admin`; becomes admin when it signs `accept_admin`. Default = none.

fields.name: approver
docs: Backend key that must co-sign every `buy_pack`.

fields.name: tree_funder
docs: Backend key allowed to call `create_tree` (besides the admin). It only spends its own SOL.

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops `buy_pack` and `admin_mint` for every expansion (already paid packs can still be opened).

fields.name: booty_destination
docs: The shop wallet's $BOOTY token account.

fields.name: active_tree
docs: Tree every mint goes into. Default = none yet.

fields.name: standby_tree
docs: Spare tree, promoted by `rotate_tree` when the active tree is nearly full. Default = none.

fields.name: vault
docs: Program-owned $BOOTY token account (PDA ["vault", booty_mint], authority = config) that holds a pack's price
between `buy_pack` and `open_pack` / the admin's `refund_pack`.

fields.name: open_fee_lamports
docs: Lamports the player deposits with every purchase; `open_pack` pays them to whoever sends it, so the opener's
transaction fee is covered by the player.

fields.name: retry_fee_lamports
docs: Lamports paid from the player's retry pool for each `seal_pack` / `redraw_pack` (only needed when opening is
delayed or after an outage).

fields.name: refund_after_secs
docs: Seconds after purchase before the admin may refund an unopened pack (so a refund never races a slow opener).

fields.name: pending_packs
docs: Purchases not yet opened or refunded.

fields.name: reserved_leaves
docs: Tree leaves promised to pending packs; `buy_pack` only sells when active + standby trees have room for them.

fields.name: paid_retries
docs: How many seals/redraws the player's deposit pays for (the retry pool is `retry_fee_lamports * paid_retries`).
The unused part of the pool goes back to the player when the pack is opened.

types.name: Expansion
docs: One card expansion (First Crush = 1). PDA ["expansion", id as u16 LE].

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops `buy_pack` and `admin_mint` for this expansion. New expansions start paused.

fields.name: collection_mint
docs: Token Metadata collection the cards join (First Crush: CARDZ...).

fields.name: creator
docs: Royalty creator (unverified, 100% share).

fields.name: uri_prefix
docs: Shared start of every card URI; each card stores the rest.

fields.name: weights_regular
docs: Rarity weights for every slot except the last.

fields.name: weights_guaranteed
docs: Rarity weights for the last slot (the guarantee, e.g. Rare or better).

fields.name: price_booty
docs: List prices in whole tokens, mirrored from the shop catalog. 0 = not sold for that currency.

fields.name: discount_percent
docs: One discount at a time, in whole percent (1-99), active while discount_start <= now < discount_end. It applies
to both currencies, rounded like the shop catalog: round(list * (100 - percent) / 100), at least 1.

fields.name: sale_start
docs: Availability period for `buy_pack` (the catalog's availability window); 0 = open on that side.

types.name: LustConfig
docs: $LUST payments. PDA ["lust"]. A $LUST price is split on opening: `split_bps[i]` to `destinations[i]` (team,
giveaway, stake, absorption pool), the remainder is burned (shop default 10 / 10 / 45 / 25, burn 10).

fields.name: vault
docs: PDA ["vault", mint], authority = config.

fields.name: price
docs: Raw units of the payment mint.

fields.name: first_leaf_index
docs: Leaf index of the first card; card i has leaf index first_leaf_index + i.

fields.name: retry_pool
docs: What is left of the player's retry deposit; returned to the player when the PendingPack closes.

types.name: PendingPack
docs: A paid, not yet opened pack. PDA ["pack", player, order_id]. Closed by `open_pack` (or the admin's `refund_pack`),
which return its rent to the player. The draw inputs (weights and card counts) are frozen here at purchase, so
later admin edits to the expansion cannot change a paid pack.

fields.name: price
docs: $BOOTY held in the vault for this pack.

fields.name: purchase_slot
docs: Slot of the `buy_pack` transaction. The cards come from the hash of this slot, which does not exist until
the slot is complete (after the purchase is irreversible).

fields.name: sealed
docs: Set by `seal_pack` / `open_pack`: the hash the draw uses.

fields.name: open_fee
docs: Paid to whoever opens the pack (from the player's deposit, on top of the rent).

fields.name: retry_fee
docs: Paid per seal/redraw while the retry pool lasts.

fields.name: rarity_counts
docs: Cards per rarity at purchase. Cards are only appended, so the first `rarity_counts[r]` cards of rarity r are
the same set at open time.

fields.name: redraws
docs: How many times `redraw_pack` gave this pack a new purchase slot (after an outage).

fields.name: retry_pool
docs: What is left of the player's retry deposit; returned to the player when the PendingPack closes.

fields.name: currency
docs: CURRENCY_BOOTY or CURRENCY_LUST: which vault holds `price` (raw units of that mint).
